substantive_finding.statement: capture support materially overstates how many incidents yield a USABLE executable artifact. 3 of 8 AUTO_CAPTURE_SUPPORTED fresh cases (37.5%) failed the frozen treatment-artifact requirement.

failure_modes.NON_DISCRIMINATING: finalhandler-headers — the defect manifests as malformed response headers, which the frozen fingerprint does not model, so buggy and fixed are indistinguishable (both HTTP_503)
failure_modes.NOT_REPRODUCIBLE_ON_BUGGY: koa-1961 and send-416 — the frozen replay re-issues the captured request through a normal HTTP client, which cannot reconstruct a trigger that depends on a Content-Length inconsistent with the body (koa-1961 replayed as HTTP 200 instead of the captured 500)

substantive_finding.why_it_matters_for_the_product: this is a real yield limit of executable incidents, independent of repair value: an incident can be captured, replayed offline, and still be unable to tell an engineer or agent whether the bug is present.
